entities.summary: Dr. Festus Awuah Kwofie is a Ghanaian Politician. He was a member of the Eighth Parliament of the Fourth Republic of Ghana representing the Upper Denkyira East Constituency in the Central Region on the ticket of the New Patriotic Party(NPP).
